package.name: aav_simulator
package.description: Ravensim, our own simulator, in Rust (rclrs): it took the place of gz sim and its ros_gz_bridges (Gazebo went on 16 Nov). It reads the SDF world files (aav_sim_models), moves the car, casts the roof lidar's and the radar stand-in's rays, and publishes the IMU, GPS, wheels, truth and /clock for aav_sim_models's nodes and the whole stack (sim.launch.py, the default simulator). The cameras are drawn by aav_sim_cameras (Bevy), started with it; with camera_lockstep its clock waits for their pictures.
